educationalGoal: You will work on problem solution for local society and familiar real world as team activity based on the experience of "Project Design Introduction" and "Projec t Design I." You will develop teamwork and leadership abilities. You will report t he project activities in writing and oral presentations. You will also develop com munication skills in conveying your ideas to others accurately.
advice: In "Project Design II", you will propose a solution to discovered problem in the given main theme according to the activities shown below. The proposal will be verified in "Project Design Hands-on." ・Project theme selection... discovering problems: Your team will select a project theme based on discovered pro blems in the given main theme. The project theme will be selected according to your interest, experience, and kn owledge. ・Market research and customer needs analysis ... problem clarification and setting: Research and analyze the cu rrent state of the target. Discover problems and solution based on the results obtained. Decide the project them e and research market products related to the project theme. ・Specification setting ... determination of proposal specification and goal setting: Create specifications befo re proposing the solution. The specifications should be established based on the collected information from the market research and the customer needs analysis. ・Idea creation and improvement... idea creation to satisfy specifications and solve the problem: Create various ideas (solution concept) to solve the problem. Improve the ideas (concepts) by checking the specifications. In addition, clarify contrivance and feasibility of the idea (concept).

activityGoals.body: Be able to discover problems from main theme.
Be able to collect various information related to the problem identified.
Be able to create multiple proposals which lead to the solution to the problem.
Be able to make a plan to realize the solution proposal.
Be able to communicate about technical information using figures and other forms of presentation
Be able to self-check own abilities.

You can make a detailed execution plan for "Project D esign Hands-on." 4. You can summarize activity results using PowerPoint s lides and poster and can report theme clearly. You can a lso respond to questions and answer in an appropriate ma nner.
